summary: S. 4344 is a bill that extends the authority of section 702 of the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act of 1978 for three years, changing the expiration date to April 20, 2029.

affected_groups.effect: Their authority to operate under section 702 of the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act of 1978 is extended for an additional three years until April 20, 2029.
affected_groups.group: Federal government intelligence and surveillance agencies

key_provisions: Extends section 702 authority of the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act of 1978 until April 20, 2029.
Amends the effective dates in section 403(b) of the FISA Amendments Act of 2008.
Makes conforming amendments to section 404(b)(1) of the FISA Amendments Act of 2008 to update headings to the April 20, 2029 date.
